title: Studio Budget Efficiency Shift
scenario: Identify studios that have released games with an increasing budget per unit of critic_score over time.
tableSchema: developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT, budget NUMERIC), ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC), games (game_id INT, release_year INT)
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name FROM (SELECT studio_name, (budget / critic_score) as efficiency, LAG(budget / critic_score) OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year) as prev_eff FROM developers d JOIN ratings r ON d.game_id = r.game_id JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id) t WHERE efficiency > prev_eff;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT, budget NUMERIC); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC); CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT);
